newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon bank to list shares on bourse end of Dec.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon bank to list shares on bourse end of Dec.

text.p: Shares of Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce will be listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange by the end of the year, the bourse said in a statement issued on Tuesday.
It said the committee approved the BLC request, making it the first bank to trade its shares on the BSE under a recent law allowing banks to trade 30 percent of their shares.
The BLC ranked 14th among Lebanon's 82 commercial banks in 1994 in the size of its customer deposits.

"The listing of the shares will add to the trading activity and liquidity of the market and will open the way for more initial public offering on the exchange," Alain Balian, Deputy Manager for structured Finance at Lebanon Invest said.
Nine shares of five companies are currently trading on the BSE: Solidere, Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramics.
Trade on the Beirut Stock Exchange has been quiet since it re-opened in January after a 13-year closure during the 1975-1990 civil war.
